title: Generated a 3D viking asset pack using assetpack.ai
author: josiahsrc
selftext: We're working on [assetpack.ai](https://assetpack.ai/) so that we can generate consistent 3D asset packs for games. What do you guys think about the quality so far?

replies.author: josiahsrc
replies.body: Just 3d for now, planning to do 2d at a later point :)

comments.author: Zinlencer
comments.body: Is the viking asset pack downloadable or is it just an image? The description made me think it's the former

replies.author: josiahsrc
replies.body: It’s not downloadable rn, but I can set up a link if you want!

replies.author: josiahsrc
replies.body: Website now has a download button for that asset pack! https://assetpack.ai/

replies.author: cs_cast_away_boi
replies.body: i’m actually highly interested in this. Can you tell me the specifics of how this works? As a roblox dev, i’d like to get decent looking assets with low poly count.

replies.author: josiahsrc
replies.body: Sure thing! Here's a video walkthrough on how it works: https://youtu.be/8E3fxjr754I. Each generated model will have a polycount that's proportional to its scale, relative to your asset pack's overall polycount setting.

comments.author: Broad-Item-2665
comments.body: Super impressive- love the style of the lil chibi one especially!

replies.author: josiahsrc
replies.body: There's an updated example on the website with lots more assets :) https://assetpack.ai/

replies.author: josiahsrc
replies.body: The main difference is that assetpack.ai generates consistently styled models in bulk by default. We're still super early, so the mesh/texture quality is probably not as good as Meshy's, but we're working on it :)

comments.body: Really curious to test it, how can we have an access? by the way your discord link is not working on your site.

comments.author: Rachel_reddit_
comments.body: Is it just for video games? Or could it be used for Adobe after effects? Do you have to use the prebuilt asset packs or is it AI where you type in a prompt like cats and it gives you a whole 3-D set of cat models?

replies.author: josiahsrc
replies.body: You can use it for whatever! It’s an AI that generates asset packs
